subject: Next steps: throughput & latency deep dive — availability check
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orionbank.com>; Kunal Mehta <kunal.mehta@orionbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed deep-dive windows

Hi Priya / Kunal —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned before the technical deep dive: 

- Primary goal: support real-time fraud-scoring use case for customer-facing transactions.
- Target throughput: ~3k tokens/sec sustained across peak slices; burst to 6k+ for short windows.
- Latency target: p95 inference <= 250ms for 2k token context (incl. KV cache).
- Data residency: production workloads will run in our VPC in us-west-2; no customer data leaves the environment.
- Security ask: Priya mentioned SOC2 + audit log export and KMS integration — we’ll include our security lead on the sizing call.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute "throughput & latency deep dive" with our solutions engineer to validate the workload profile, run a quick baseline test plan, and produce a dedicated sizing recommendation (GPU pool profile, batching/kv config). Suggested windows (PT):
  - Thu 26 Feb, 09:00–10:00 PT
  - Thu 26 Feb, 13:00–14:00 PT
  - Fri 27 Feb, 08:00–09:00 PT

If none of those work, please toss a few windows that do. I attached a short template to capture the workload details (sample corpus size, request distribution, payload sizes) — filling that out before the call will make the session much more efficient.

Attachments: throughput_requirements_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Links: https://calendly.com/redwood/throughput-deep-dive — feel free to book a slot directly.

I'll also loop Grace (solutions eng) and Marissa (AE) on the calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

--

Connor —

Appreciate the clear recap. The targets look right; a few clarifications before the call:
- We typically see 10–15% long-tail requests that hit large context windows (~4k tokens) — would like to understand how that affects pooling/kv cache sizing.
- Security: please include your security contact who can walk through audit log retention and KMS flow.
- Procurement: we are on an accelerated timeline for Q2 production pilots; need a rough TCO estimate by the end of March.

Availability: Thu 26 Feb works best for us but the 13:00–14:00 PT slot would be preferred (that’s 16:00–17:00 ET). Can you confirm if Grace can make that time? If not, Fri 27 08:00–09:00 PT is our fallback.

Also looping in Kunal who will be technical lead from Orion on the call.

Best,
